lesson: Foreign investor flow momentum as a regime-conditional alpha source in Korean equities is conceptually valid — foreign flows are highly informative in emerging markets (Froot et al. 2001, Richards 2005). STR_887 achieves FMB t=5.50 and 63% OOS retention, confirming cross-sectional signal validity. However, two PIT violations remain: (1) C10 liquidity filter includes same-day volume, (2) C11 Soft MRS uses same-month FRED data. The deprecated Soft MRS (L-441) should be replaced with Regime Engine v7.1. Investor data only covers 2020+, so pre-2020 months default to neutral regime — a structural limitation that caps alpha. Turnover 186% annualized is acceptable (contrast STR_1422 at 3205%). Fix C10/C11, replace MRS, then re-evaluate.
